name: sbozor
description: SBOZOR — root orkestratsiya skriptlari. Xostda `make` yo'q (Windows), shuning uchun barcha yorliqlar shu yerda.

scripts.//compose-files: ⛔ HAR SKRIPTDA `-f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml` OSHKORA YOZILADI VA QISQARTIRILMAYDI. Sabab ikkita va ikkalasi ham o'lchangan: (1) compose fayllari `deployment/` ga ko'chgach AVTOMATIK TOPISH o'chdi — `docker compose` `compose.yaml` ni faqat joriy papkadan qidiradi; (2) `-f` berilishi bilan `compose.override.yml` ning AVTOMATIK birlashuvi ham o'chadi — uni ro'yxatdan olib tashlasangiz dev stek `--reload` siz, portlarsiz va bind-mount'siz ko'tariladi va buni faqat kod o'zgarishi ilovaga yetib bormaganda sezasiz. PROD boshqa juftlik ishlatadi (`compose.prod.yml`) va u `ops/docs/go-live.md` da. ⚠ `.env` ham `deployment/` da: compose uni loyiha papkasidan o'qiydi va u endi `deployment/`. Ildizda qolsa stek BO'SH PAROLLAR bilan jimgina ko'tarilardi (o'lchangan: exit 0, faqat warning).
scripts.//up: ⛔ RO'YXAT MAHSULOT KOMPONENTLARINING TO'LIQ TO'PLAMI BO'LISHI SHART. 07 `deferred-items.md` №5 ning darsi: hujjatlangan buyruq mahsulotni KO'TARISHI kerak, aks holda profilsiz qilingan komponent baribir ishga tushmaydi va nosozlik `docker compose ps` da ko'rinmaydi. `backup` shu sababdan bu yerda (08-05, FOUND-07).
scripts.up: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml up -d db cache storage core-api worker scheduler cv-service bot-service go2rtc backup --wait
scripts.migrate: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile migrate run --rm migrate alembic upgrade head
scripts.revision: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile migrate run --rm migrate alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.test: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests pytest -q
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/unit -x -q
scripts.test:fast: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/unit -x -q
scripts.test:tenancy: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/tenancy -q
scripts.sim:up: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile sim up -d nvr-sim nvr-sim-rtsp go2rtc storage --wait
scripts.sim:down: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile sim stop nvr-sim nvr-sim-rtsp go2rtc storage
scripts.test:sim: npm run sim:up && docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/integration -m "sim and not slow" -x -q
scripts.test:sim:slow: npm run sim:up && docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/integration -m "sim and slow" -x -q
scripts.lint: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.cv:test: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm cv-tests pytest -q
scripts.cv:lint: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm cv-tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.bot:test: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm bot-tests pytest -q
scripts.bot:lint: docker compose -f deployment/compose.yaml -f deployment/compose.override.yml --profile test run --rm bot-tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.//gate-budget: BYUDJET 2300 s (06-14 dan keyin orkestrator qayta belgiladi; oldingi qiymat 1250 s, 05-15). O'SISH TO'PLAMNING O'SISHIDAN, ifloslanishdan EMAS: 6-faza 173 ta backend testi qo'shdi (integratsiya+tenancy 141: criteria 12, billing_repo 30, payments 27, shifts 21, billing_api 19, billing_immutable 12, billing_domain_meta 13, billing_close 7; unit 32) va vitest 620 -> 717, ustiga uchta yangi marshrut (/collect, /collect/shift, /billing) uchala locale'da SSG build'ga qo'shildi. Nazorat o'lchovi: gate:fast 160 s. Bu kalit npm uchun IZOH: ishga tushirilmaydi va gate zanjiriga kirmaydi. 7-FAZADA ZANJIRGA `bot:lint` + `bot:test` QO'SHILDI (07-01): kutilgan qo'shimcha ~45 s (konteyner ko'tarilishi + ~25 s test + ~20 s ruff/mypy), byudjet 2300 s DA QOLADI va qayta o'lchov faza yopilishida (07-17) bajariladi. --- 07-17 DA QAYTA O'LCHANDI (2026-08-12), TINCH XOSTDA, UCH MARTA, UCHALASI HAM exit 0: 1424 s / 1263 s / 1349 s -- tarqoqlik 161 s (eng yomonning 11.3 %). Eng yomon 1424 s < 2300 s, ya'ni BYUDJET O'ZGARMAYDI va zaxira 876 s. Nazorat: gate:fast 80 s (byudjet 200 s). TO'PLAM O'SDI: vitest 717 -> 806 (+89), backend pytest jami 3101 (unit 1218 + integratsiya 1152 + tenancy 731) va zanjirga bot:lint + bot:test qo'shildi. ⛔ RAQAM 06-14 NIKI (1703/1733/1899) BILAN TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI SOLISHTIRILMAYDI VA BU HALOLLIK BANDI: bu o'lchovdan oldin xostda sbozor-cv-service-1 QAYTA-QAYTA YIQILIB TURGAN edi (CV_MODEL_PATH /app/models/rfdetr-large.onnx YO'Q -> taskiq worker-0 har ~1 s da qayta ishga tushadi) va u ~80 % CPU yeyardi; u to'xtatilgandan keyin o'lchov ~2 barobar tezlashdi. Byudjet shu sababdan ham PASAYTIRILMADI. --- 08-20 DA QAYTA O'LCHANDI (2026-08-16), TINCH XOSTDA (oltita `parnikkpi-*` + qayta-qayta yiqilayotgan `sbozor-bot-service-1` to'xtatildi va o'lchovdan keyin TIKLANDI), IKKALASI HAM exit 0: 1909 s / 1842 s -- tarqoqlik 67 s (eng yomonning 3.5 %). Eng yomon 1909 s < 2300 s, ya'ni BYUDJET O'ZGARMAYDI va zaxira 391 s (17 %). Nazorat: gate:fast 155 s / 152 s (byudjet 200 s, O'ZGARMADI). O'SISH TO'PLAMNIKI: to'rt yangi integratsiya fayli (test_reports_api, test_three_way, test_backup_heartbeat, test_restore_drill), uch unit fayli, test_phase8_criteria.py (30 hodisali doira + ikki .xlsx zanjiri), test_restore_drill ning IKKINCHI postgres konteyneri va ikki yangi SSG marshruti x 3 locale. ⛔ HALOLLIK BANDI: UCH EMAS, IKKI o'lchov olindi -- ijro paytida tezlik ustuvor deb belgilandi va uchinchisi BOSHLANMADI. Tarqoqlik tor (3.5 %), lekin «uch marta o'lchandi» da'vosi BERILMAYDI: darvoza byudjet sababli yolg'on qizil bersa, birinchi shubha shu yerga tushadi. Qiymat 08-VALIDATION.md da AYNAN shunday yozilgan. --- 09-07 DA QAYTA O'LCHANDI (2026-08-17), TINCH XOSTDA (oltita `parnikkpi-*` + restart halqasidagi `sbozor-bot-service-1` to'xtatildi va o'lchovdan keyin TIKLANDI), IKKALASI HAM exit 0: 2259 s / 2102 s -- tarqoqlik 157 s (eng yomonning 7,0 %). Eng yomon 2259 s < 2300 s, ya'ni BYUDJET O'ZGARMAYDI va zaxira 41 s (1,8 %). ⚠ ZAXIRA KRITIK TOR: keyingi fazaning birinchi qo'shimchasi chegarani NUQSON SABABLI EMAS tripplashi ehtimoli yuqori -- protokol bo'yicha bugun ko'tarilmadi (eng yomon chegaradan PAST), keyingi qayta o'lchovda ko'tarish kutiladi. O'SISH TO'PLAMNIKI: 9-faza skript-darvozalari ~296 -> 349 (contrast 10, motion-tokens 10, theme-tokens, typography 6, collect-surface +5, phase9-criteria 8) va vitest 1110 -> 1170 (+60: xoreografiya 12, collect-session +4, dashboard kartalari ~23, locale-switcher 9). ⛔ HALOLLIK BANDI: UCH EMAS, IKKI yaroqli o'lchov olindi (08-20 presedenti, tezlik ustuvor deb belgilandi). Yana IKKI YAROQSIZ urinish bo'ldi va ular O'LCHOV EMAS -- zanjir backend'da uzilib to'liq davomiylikni bermagan (ikkalasi ham 1871 s nuqtada uzildi): (1) dushanba-ko'rlik: test_billing_api va test_phase6_criteria dagi ikki test 'bugun ochiq kun' prekonditsiyasini o'rnatmagan va 2026-08-17 (dushanba; seed A_OPEN_WEEKDAYS=2..7, A bozori dushanba yopiq) kuni market_closed bilan DETERMINISTIK qizardi -- bu zanjir birinchi marta dushanba kuni yugurtirilganda ochildi; 11a4f3a arrange qadamiga open_weekdays=1..7 UPDATE qo'shdi (test-prekonditsiya, mahsulot yo'liga NOL ta'sir); (2) meros flake deferred №12 (test_phase5_criteria::test_sc4, o'lchangan ehtimol 1/70=1,4 %) bir marta tripladi -- 08-20 scope-boundary qarori bo'yicha TEGILMADI. --- 10-08 DA QAYTA O'LCHANDI (2026-08-17/18), TINCH XOSTDA (oltita parnikkpi-* + restart halqasidagi sbozor-bot-service-1 to'xtatildi va o'lchovdan keyin TIKLANDI), UCH YAROQLI O'LCHOV, UCHALASI HAM exit 0: 2227 s / 1856 s / 1760 s -- tarqoqlik 467 s (eng yomonning 21,0 %; birinchi o'lchov sovuq keshda, keyingi ikkitasi issiqda). Eng yomon 2227 s < 2300 s, ya'ni BYUDJET O'ZGARMAYDI va zaxira 73 s (3,3 %). W0-13 formulasi bo'yicha ko'tarish SHARTI tug'ilmadi (eng yomon chegaradan PAST) va bu ham yoziladi: zaxira hamon tor, 11-faza o'z birinchi qo'shimchasida qayta baholasin. O'SISH TO'PLAMNIKI: backend pytest 3101 -> 3191 (+90, jumladan test_demo_request.py ning 7-band anonim zanjiri va test_demo_request_contract.py unit fayli), vitest 1170 -> 1197 (+27: hero-scene, demo-form, locale-switcher, reveal marketing testlari), skript darvozalari 349 -> 386 (+37: landing-surface 20 band, phase10-criteria 8 test, error-codes oltinchi juftlik) va next build +3 SSG marshrut (jami 86). HALOLLIK BANDI: UCH YAROQLI o'lchov olindi (06-14 dan beri birinchi to'liq uchlik) va yana UCH YAROQSIZ urinish bo'ldi, ular O'LCHOV EMAS: (1) fon ijro seansi ~66-daqiqada o'ldirildi -- ikkinchi urinish backend 57 % da uzilib to'liq davomiylik bermadi (vosita muhitining fon-vazifa chegarasi, mahsulot nuqsoni EMAS); (2) 1845 s exit 1 -- meros flake deferred №12 (test_phase5_criteria::test_sc4, o'lchangan ehtimol 1/70 = 1,4 %) tripladi, o'lchov YAROQSIZ deb belgilanib qaytadan olindi, flake 08-20 scope-boundary qarori bo'yicha TEGILMADI; (3) ikkinchi fon seansi ham o'ldirildi -- uchinchi urinish vitest yakunidan keyin, build bosqichida uzildi (yana vosita chegarasi). Qolgan uchtasi ALOHIDA fon seanslarida to'liq o'tdi.
